title: Review of c31's layer-holds-cargo finding: replicated on fresh seed 2 (in/out 8.6-12.6 with the layer's exclusion vs 1.7-2.0 without; 74-80% vs 26-32% of the cargo held)
summary: Looked at koff_cmp.png and wtable.txt first, then read world2.py: the layer species s is made inside the body (kp*phi) and adsorbs at the interface; the cargo c is made inside the body and has chemical potential ln c + kappa s, so the cell's own layer excludes it (Scharfetter-Gummel face flux). Re-ran world2.py in labkit on seed 2 to t=12 (rerun/) and the claim's cargoprobe.py on seed 2 with kappa=10 and with the kappa=0 ablation (probe/). Over t=1-12: kappa=10 in/out ratio min 8.56, median 12.57, rear side min 5.18, median 8.31, held fraction 0.74-0.80 (median 0.80), ratio >= 2 in every sample; kappa=0 ratio min 1.68, median 1.98, rear 1.05-1.16, held 0.26-0.32, ratio >= 2 in 48% of samples. labkit on the rerun: s rim/core 1.86, rim/outside 15.1 (6/6 membrane-like); cargo c rim/core 2.7, rim/outside 16.5 (5/6), peaking at the rim (rho 0.85) as the finding's picture shows (cargo piled inside the rim); the cell crawls 3.1 body lengths with a bright rim layer and a faint cargo wake (rerun/sheet.png).

observations.F: probe/k10_s2.json vs probe/k0_s2.json: in/out median 12.57 vs 1.98, rear 8.31 vs 1.16, held 0.80 vs 0.32 (t=1-12); rerun/FACTS.md radial s and c membrane-like

seeds_run.result: pass: kappa=10 vs kappa=0 numbers within the claim's ranges

controls_run.F: probe/k0_s2.json: matched kappa=0 ablation (same cargo production, same seed)

not_checked: 1.5x resolution change (needed before W can be claimed)
verdicts.limitation: The exclusion is a coded coupling (the cargo's potential contains kappa*s); what the finding shows is that the cell's own adsorbed layer, through it, keeps a cargo inside a moving body, and that the ablation removes the contrast. The cell is planted (one disk), there is no division, and the rim and the cargo peak are a few pixels wide, so the RUBRIC W resolution test is still owed. One fresh seed.
